data_decision.operator_feedback_policy: Only creator/operator rows already included through the governed build manifest are part of this benchmark truth.
data_decision.exclusion_reason: Ordinary local/public-user feedback remains supplemental runtime evidence until a controlled adjudication and split-governance path promotes it.
data_decision.raw_media_policy: No raw media is copied into this artifact; rows retain compact route/context metrics only.

score_contract.reranking_direction_expected: higher UI truth score promotes; higher raw risk demotes
